items.guidance: Search the server code for an existing route that answers on port 8080 without a login. If you add one and the server is a Meteor app, register it as a server-side HTTP handler, for example on WebApp connectHandlers, so it runs before client routing and login checks. Return 200 without a MongoDB query.

Check whether the server reads MONGO_URL on startup and whether its collections are stored through the mongodb driver on the main runtime path. Report the files and that MONGO_URL is required, and report any setting that selects another database, if one exists.
